name: home-billiards
description: Home Billiards storefront, admin, backend, and shared packages

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:backend && npm run build:storefront && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @home-billiards/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @home-billiards/storefront && npm run typecheck --workspace @home-billiards/admin
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @home-billiards/contracts && npm run test --workspace @home-billiards/backend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
